turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good afternoon, Orion Shield Insurance, Sofia speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, a stone cracked my windscreen and I'm stressed about the cost. How much would I have to pay? My policy number is OS-708242.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That sounds like a really tough few days. Let's get this sorted out for you. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Aiko Tanaka.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sorry, I didn't quite get all of that. Can you go through what's happened again from the start?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Of course, as I said, a stone cracked my windscreen and I'm stressed about the cost. How much would I have to pay?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is it only the windscreen that's damaged?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, just the windscreen.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So it'll definitely be covered?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise the outcome, the claims team decides, but windscreen damage is something many policies cover.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, any settlement will be subject to the policy excess and the indemnity limit, and we may pursue subrogation against the other party's insurer.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I don't follow, what does any of that mean?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's all in the policy wording, I'm afraid. Anyway, let's move on.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 0:26]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, I appreciate your patience. For windscreen-only claims the excess, which is the amount you pay towards a claim yourself, is $100. For other motor claims it's $250.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. Someone will get back to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've explained the excess that applies.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
